title: Cloudflare (API token with read scopes; OPA over tofu state)

checks.title: Zone minimum TLS version is 1.2 or higher
checks.scope: Traffic through the Cloudflare proxy; encryption inside the vendor's network is not visible.

checks.title: TLS 1.3 is enabled at the edge
checks.scope: Edge only.

checks.title: HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS
checks.scope: Edge only.

checks.title: Automatic HTTPS rewrites are on
checks.scope: Edge only.

checks.title: Origin connections use Full (strict) TLS
checks.scope: Edge to origin only.

checks.title: HSTS of at least one year, including subdomains
checks.scope: Browsers reaching the zone through Cloudflare.

checks.title: DNSSEC is active on the zone
checks.scope: The zone's authoritative DNS, when Cloudflare is the zone's DNS provider.

checks.title: A managed WAF ruleset runs on every inbound request
checks.scope: Inbound HTTP(S) through the Cloudflare proxy; outbound and non-HTTP traffic are not covered.

checks.title: The account enforces two-factor authentication
checks.scope: Access to the Cloudflare dashboard only; the API does not say whether factors resist phishing.

checks.title: Every accepted member has two-factor authentication on
checks.scope: Cloudflare dashboard members only.

checks.title: The account audit log records configuration changes
checks.scope: Cloudflare configuration changes; whether someone reviews them is attested in sos-app.

checks.title: The zone's security level challenges visitors with a poor IP reputation
checks.scope: Inbound HTTP(S) through the Cloudflare proxy; passes at any level above essentially_off.

checks.title: Browser Integrity Check is on
checks.scope: Inbound HTTP(S) through the Cloudflare proxy; a header heuristic, not a full bot defence.

checks.title: Custom WAF rules block or challenge traffic on the zone
checks.scope: Inbound HTTP(S) through the Cloudflare proxy; shows enabled block or challenge rules exist, not that they are the right ones.

checks.title: Rate limiting rules are enabled on the zone
checks.scope: Inbound HTTP(S) through the Cloudflare proxy; Cloudflare's network-layer DDoS protection is always on and not judged here.

checks.title: Bot Fight Mode, or Super Bot Fight Mode acting on definitely automated traffic, is on
checks.scope: Inbound HTTP(S) through the Cloudflare proxy; Enterprise Bot Management (rules on the bot score) is reported as skipped.

checks.title: Leaked credential detection is on for logins through the zone
checks.scope: Logins to the customer's application that pass through Cloudflare; detection only, the customer's rules decide what happens.

checks.title: Every edge certificate pack is active and not near expiry
checks.scope: Certificates Cloudflare serves at the edge; more than 30 days left for uploaded certificates, more than 14 for Cloudflare-managed ones. Origin certificates are not visible.

checks.title: Every custom hostname (Cloudflare for SaaS) requires TLS 1.2 or higher
checks.scope: Custom hostnames on the zone; a hostname without its own setting is judged on the zone's minimum TLS.

checks.title: Client-side security (Page Shield) monitors the scripts pages load
checks.scope: Scripts and connections seen in visitors' browsers on the zone; Pro plan or higher.

checks.title: Cloudflare serves a security.txt with a contact
checks.scope: A security.txt served by Cloudflare's Security Center; one served by the origin is not visible and gives a fail.

checks.title: Few members hold Super Administrator
checks.scope: Cloudflare account members; the threshold (default 3) is the collector's --max-super-admins.

checks.title: Every active account-owned API token has an expiry
checks.scope: Account-owned tokens only; tokens owned by individual users are not readable with an account token.

checks.title: A notification policy alerts on attacks or security findings
checks.scope: Cloudflare notification policies for DDoS, WAF anomaly, bot, BGP hijack, security insight and client-side security alert types; who reads the alerts is attested in sos-app.

checks.title: Every Access application has an allow policy that names who may enter, and no bypass for everyone
checks.scope: Applications behind Cloudflare Access; applications not behind Access are not visible.

checks.title: Every allow policy of an Access application requires MFA
checks.scope: Applications behind Cloudflare Access; MFA enforced only at the identity provider is not visible and gives a fail, and the factor's phishing resistance is not shown.

checks.title: Access application sessions last 24 hours or less
checks.scope: Applications behind Cloudflare Access; an unset duration is Access's default of 24 hours.

checks.title: Gateway has an enabled DNS block rule
checks.scope: Outbound DNS from devices and networks that resolve through Cloudflare Gateway; other resolvers are not visible.

checks.title: Device posture rules are defined
checks.scope: Devices enrolled in Cloudflare One; shows rules exist, not that every Access policy requires them.

checks.title: No R2 bucket is public through its r2.dev domain
checks.scope: R2 buckets in the default jurisdiction; public access through a custom domain is a deliberate choice and not judged.
